## Activity

During December 2022, Central Eye Clinic completed 161 captures. Activity was recorded for the month as part of the clinic’s routine operational reporting. The volume provides the basis for reviewing image quality and subsequent grading outcomes.

## Image quality

Of the 161 captures, 5 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 3.1. The result indicates that most captures were suitable for assessment, while a small proportion could not be used for grading. The site should continue routine attention to capture technique and image quality to support consistent assessment.

## Grading

A total of 40 results were graded referable. The median lag from capture to grading was 2 days. This provides an overview of grading timeliness for the reporting period and should be considered alongside the number of captures and the image-quality result.

Staff raised no new equipment faults during December 2022. Overall, the report records activity, image usability, referable findings, and grading timeliness for Central Eye Clinic.
